pin_rule: Under the common lock reconcile every exact admitted display source and saved report record, runtime/build receipts and three sample arrays. .NET JIT must execute the pinned dotnet host/DLL; NativeAOT must execute its pinned produced native binary. Report/backend labels alone are insufficient. No new timings or edits to historical reports.
